title: The names lupin hides behind
standfirst: Lupin goes by many names on a label. Here is the list we read for you.

spans.text: The law makes a maker name lupin when they put it in on purpose. It does not make them use the word you are looking for.

blocks.label: names we watch for on a label
blocks.caption: Counted only where the link to lupin is settled. Names that depend on the product are listed further down, and are not in this count.

resolved.method: Names whose link to lupin is settled, counted from our allergen registry.
resolved.excludedNote: 8 more depend on the product or are shared with something else, so they are listed separately rather than counted here.

resolved.limit: We read what a label says. We cannot see what a maker left off it.

spans.text: These depend on the product. We treat them with care, and we say so on the label reading rather than guessing.
Names that look close but are not lupin. These are the ones you can stop worrying about.
What we do when the label is unclear
If we cannot tell, we warn you. On this one thing we would rather be wrong in the direction of caution than quiet.
